title: Italy raises Macse energy storage auction premium cap from €22,000 to €27,000/MWh
content:
Italy’s energy regulator, Arera, has raised the MACSE auction premium cap to €27,000/MWh per year, up from €22,000/MWh proposed in July, mainly due to higher benchmark investment costs. The new cap affects project economics and guarantees, while developers must weigh the 15-year fixed premium against potential merchant revenues when setting their bids.

title: Austria to enable peer-to-peer electricity sharing from October
content:

Reduced grid charges for peer-to-peer arrangements are expected to take effect from January 2027, with nationwide implementation planned from April 2027.

title: US clean energy jobs fell for the first time since the pandemic
